slides.texte_overlay:
Small acts of kindness
that make men unforgettable
Holding the door and actually smiling. Not a quick push, a real moment of attention. Small courtesy turns a grey morning into a better one for someone.
Letting someone go ahead in the queue. The person with two items, the tired parent. Thirty seconds of your time can make someone's whole day.
Thanking the people nobody thanks. The cleaner, the bus driver, the security guard. A sincere "thank you" means more than you know.
Helping a friend move without being asked. Show up with a van, a coffee and good energy. People remember who was there on moving day.
Before: I never knew what to say to cheer someone up. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I always have a story that helps.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I never knew what to say to cheer someone up. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I always have a story that helps.

slides.texte_overlay: Sending a photo of an old memory. "Found this, remember that trip?" A small message like that can brighten someone's whole week.
Giving credit in public. "This was his idea." Praising someone in front of others shows real confidence and generosity. It costs nothing and people never forget it.
